article.hook: Some voices don’t ask for attention - they demand it. When Mercury moves through Leo, words arrive with fire and a need to be witnessed. You’ll notice conversations full of bold claims and a rush to captivate.
article.lived: For the next few weeks, speech feels like stepping onto a stage. We speak with more color - our sentences flare with confidence and a hint of performance. It’s the kind of talk that turns heads in the room, whether you’re telling a story or pitching an idea. The mind leans into showmanship, and simple facts come dressed in drama and flair.
article.turn: The same spark that draws eyes can scorch the message until it’s all about applause. When the need to impress outweighs the need to connect, the truth becomes a prop, not the point. Watch for conversations where pride drowns out listening. Say what matters, not what dazzles - because clout without clarity leaves the room empty.
moves: Read a poem or story aloud to an audience, even if it’s one person.
Start a conversation by stating your main point before the details.
Notice when you’re holding back to avoid sounding too showy and lean in instead.
